name: Alien X

traits: Three personalities: Serena (love), Bellicus (rage), Ben (reason)
Ben swore never to use him again after his debut
Recreated the universe from scratch (So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies)
Body is rigid - only other Celestialsapiens can move him
abilities: Omnipotent reality warping - thoughts become real; recreated the entire universe
Time and space manipulation (time waves, energy vortexes)
Near-invulnerability (unharmed while the Annihilarrgh erased the universe)
Telekinesis, mind control, energy deflection
Shapeshifting, teleportation, force fields, size alteration, self-duplication
Planet-destroying strength; flight and space survival
Regeneration of severed limbs
Can pierce the Contumelia's extradimensional field
weaknesses: Serena and Bellicus must agree with Ben before Alien X can act at all - deadlock leaves him motionless (crippling in AF/UA)
Other Celestialsapiens can neutralise or reverse his actions
Cannot directly manipulate manna; magic can cancel his powers
Powers may not work in universes with incompatible cosmic laws
Vulnerable to Osmosian/Darkstar power absorption, Vladat draining and Nemuina sleeping dust
Professor Paradox and the DNA scanner can force him to revert
notableFeats: Stopped a dam flood before deadlocking (X = Ben + 2)
Almost had Paradox voted out of existence (The Forge of Creation)
Recreated a near-identical universe after the Annihilarrgh destroyed it (So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies)
Defeated the Galactic Gladiator to win his trial (Universe vs. Tennyson)
Fought the Rooters and the brainwashed Amalgam Kids (Weapon XI: Part 1)

appearances.designNotes: Solid black humanoid with white hands, tiny white star specks, pupil-less green eyes, three forehead horns; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest. Ben is the tiebreaker vote (2 of 3 carries a motion) in AF/UA.
Same design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

appearances.firstEpisode: So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies
notableEpisodes: So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies
appearances.designNotes: Largely the same: bigger chin, more muscular, smaller horns, brighter stars; Omnitrix on chest. From So Long onward all three personalities must agree, but Ben has become far better at persuading Serena and Bellicus, so Alien X is usable in fights.

score.rationale: Omnipotent reality warper who recreated the universe and beat a Celestialsapien gladiator; every dimension is creation-level. The crippling catch is the three-way vote: Serena and Bellicus deadlocked Ben into a statue in AF/UA (weaknessPenalty 5, controlPenalty 3), and even in OV, where Ben gains working control, he must still consult them. Pipeline pins the total to 200.

notes: Homeworld: Forge of Creation; Zvezda was retconned as non-existent.

Deadlock mechanics: in AF/UA Ben is a tiebreaker (two votes carry); from OV's So Long onward all three must agree, but Ben is much better at it and uses Alien X in combat (Universe vs. Tennyson, Weapon XI).
OV A New Dawn uses were mostly Skurd borrowing Alien X's DNA (sword/arm), plus one Ben cameo.
Albedo's Negative Alien X trapped him motionless for a year in an alternate timeline (mentioned only).

name: Atomic-X
summary: Ben 10,000's Biomnitrix fusion of Atomix and Alien X: Alien X's reality-bending power in a body he can actually control, with Atomix's nuclear punch on top. Erased by the Time Bomb, restored, and finally beaten by Maltruant.
traits: Only combination alien whose name doesn't reuse parts of its components' names
Has a mouth, unlike Atomix and Alien X
Also spelled 'Atomix X' in credits
Voiced by Judd Nelson
abilities: Celestialsapien reality warping usable at will - no Serena/Bellicus debate needed
Teleportation anywhere he wishes
Creates orbs of light/black holes without physical effort
Extreme strength (flicked Vilgax into the air with one finger)
Atomic/nuclear energy blasts from his fists
Enormous jumps
weaknesses: Was erased by the Chronosapien Time Bomb
Vulnerable to a Chronosapien's time rays (Maltruant)
Diluted Celestialsapien DNA makes him weaker than Alien X (Duncan Rouleau); crew statements conflict on whether he is fully omnipotent
notableFeats: Tried to stop the Chronosapien Time Bomb and was erased from existence with it (And Then There Were None)
Restored by No Watch Ben as Clockwork, then knocked Vilgax skyward with a finger flick and helped the good Bens win (And Then There Was Ben)
Teleported and conjured light/black-hole orbs at will (And Then There Was Ben)
Battled Maltruant with atomic blasts but was defeated saving Spanner (The End of an Era)

appearances.designNotes: Alien X's starfield body shape with Atomix's upper torso, collarbone, lower jaw, waist, thighs and feet and Atomix's height; large green energy-filled cylinders on the forearms and orbs on the shoulders; eyebrows shaped like Alien X's horns; has a mouth; Biomnitrix symbol on the chest.

score.rationale: Celestialsapien-grade reality warping without the personality deadlock (cosmic 9), teleportation, black-hole orbs, and enough strength to flick Vilgax away. Kept off 200 because his DNA is diluted (per Rouleau) and he was erased by a Time Bomb and beaten by Maltruant's time attacks - real, exploitable time-based weaknesses, though far less crippling than Alien X's debate.

notes: Used only by the Omniverse Ben 10,000 via the Biomnitrix (And Then There Were None: non-speaking; And Then There Was Ben: x2 - cameo then non-speaking; The End of an Era).
Omnipotence debate: Derrick J. Wyatt says Atomic-X has Alien X's powers; Duncan Rouleau says any Celestialsapien combination is weaker due to diluted DNA. Wiki leaves it to the reader.

Biomnitrix context: the Omniverse Ben 10,000 (Original Future timeline, re-established as Ben Prime's true future) wears two linked Omnitrix gauntlets; slamming them together fuses two aliens on the fly (combinations are generated at transformation time, not stored). Each gauntlet alone gives normal aliens; it is voice-controlled and can be knocked out by a large EMP or Chronosapien time-freeze. All on-screen fusions were drawn by Thomas N. Perkins IV; the device name was coined by Derrick J. Wyatt (unnamed in scripts).

Mouthless; Galvan-style symbol on his chest does not imply Galvan ties
First mentioned in the OS episode Ken 10 as one of Ben 10,000's aliens

Nuclear energy beams and radiokinesis (can even reproduce gamma radiation)

Glows in the dark

Cannot transmute matter

Kicked an object almost out of Galvan Prime's atmosphere (For a Few Brains More)
Burned up Zs'Skayr and badly hurt Lord Transyl with a Fusion Cuisine light orb, leaving it active as a permanent ward over Z'Castle Zs'Skayr (The Vampire Strikes Back)
Broke into the Rooters' headquarters (Weapon XI: Part 1)
Fought Malgax until his stamina ran out (Malgax Attacks)

appearances.designNotes: Green-and-white robotic humanoid, large arm cylinders near the wrists filled with bubbling green energy, matching energy in his Omnitrix-shaped chest core and pointed armoured helmet, green eyes, no mouth; Omnitrix symbol on green/white belt.

score.rationale: Offense 9 and energy 9: one-punched Ultimate Humungousaur, flattened Ultimate Spidermonkey with the Nuclear Winner, and his Fusion Cuisine burned an Ectonurite out of existence with a light orb that could scale to a star. Durability 8 with a hard body that took Malgax's hits, plus flight. Raw nuclear power rather than reality-bending (cosmic 0), he tires after sustained output, his overconfidence risks a meltdown, and Malgax outlasted him - so he sits below Ultimate Way Big and Alien X.

notes: Derrick J. Wyatt calls Atomix Ben's second most powerful alien after Alien X and says his powers are largely unexplored.
OS: only mentioned in Ken 10 (Ben 10,000's roster; Ken wanted him) - no OS transformation, so no OS appearance despite the wiki category 'Ben 10,000's Transformations'.
The Omniverse Ben 10,000 used the Biomnitrix fusion Atomic-X (Atomix + Alien X) - separate record atomic-x.json.
Weapon XI: Part 1 use is an off-screen activation/cameo. Comics (Super Secret Crisis War!, The Worm That Turned) not counted.
A hypothetical Ultimate Atomix would need a containment suit like NRG's (Derrick J. Wyatt).

Online/mobile games and comics (Down in the Dumps, Super Secret Crisis War!) not counted.

Perkins IV; the device name was coined by Derrick J. Wyatt (unnamed in scripts).

summary: A one-eyed walking plant with whip-vine limbs, a flytrap head and a back full of explosive fruit - stretchy, sneaky and surprisingly tough.
traits: Five vine legs in OS, four in OV
DNA donor was possessed by Zs'Skayr, which is how Ghostfreak entered the Omnitrix
Fruits can tame Gracklflints
Can merge with Earth trees
abilities: Elastic vine limbs and whip tendrils (grab, restrain, swing)
Chlorokinesis (control of plant life)
Explosive / gas-bomb / vine-growing fruit pods on his back
Thorn generation
Regeneration
Enhanced strength and durability
Burrowing
Gas immunity (no lungs)
Closeable flytrap head; plant merging
weaknesses: Vines can be tangled
Over-stretched limbs stay extended for a while
Vulnerable to electricity
Extreme cold makes him wilt and can kill him
notableFeats: Held back the Mycelium spores of Camp Opinicon (Camp Fear)
Caught Max and Gwen mid-fall and beat Hex and Charmcaster (Tough Luck)
Defeated three Null Guardians in the Null Void (Back With a Vengeance)
Dragged the Werewolf underground (Benwolf)
Defeated Kuphulu (Rad Monster Party)
Battled Eon in Ben Again

appearances.designNotes: Green skin and teeth, five vine legs, blue main eye plus a secondary blue eye on each shoulder, black fruit pods on the back, original Omnitrix on the chest.

Green skin, four legs, white teeth, shorter thicker fingers, shoulder eyes replaced by light-green patches, blue tongue, bigger flytrap; 16-year-old wears the Omnitrix on a green/white belt, 11-year-old on the chest (green).

score.rationale: Mid-tier utility fighter: stretching vines, restraints, explosive/gas fruit and regeneration cover many situations, but he lacks raw power and is undone by cold, electricity or a good tangle.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked) or Ultimate Alien (intro only; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
OV 'Ben Again': 16-year-old Ben's mind in 11-year-old Ben's body used the 11-year-old design (counted as ben-11-ov).
Also used by Ken (Ken 10), Albedo (The Ultimate Heist) and Gwen 10 (And Then There Were None / And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.

name: XLR8
summary: Ben's blue speedster: a visored raptor-like Kineceleran who moves so fast the world seems frozen and can run up walls and across water.
traits: Ball-like wheels on his feet
Slide-down face visor is biological, not mechanical
Ben 10,000's XLR8 could circle the globe in seconds
Faster on the ground than Jetray
abilities: Enhanced speed (500+ mph; time appears to stop)
Accelerated thinking and reflexes
Wall and water running (friction manipulation)
Vortex generation by running in circles
Rapid speed-kicks and scissor-claw strikes
Sharp claws
Prehensile tail
Retractable biological visor
Wind resistance
weaknesses: Magnets and charged pulses throw him off course
Slips on ice; sticks to adhesive surfaces (Sploot's goo)
Fast-reacting foes (Transylians, Tetramands, Vulpimancers) can counter him
Vulnerable to electricity
notableFeats: Beat Hex in a museum in his first real fight (Lucky Girl)
Chased down and defeated the storm entity S.A.M. (Monster Weather)
Ben 10,000's XLR8 defeated Exo-Skull (Ben 10,000)
Cycled every combination to disarm SevenSeven's bomb on Ben 23 (Store 23)
Knocked over a Way Bad (The Frogs of War: Part 2)
Saved Dr. Holiday from Alpha (Heroes United)

appearances.designNotes: Black bodysuit with a white centre stripe, black cone helmet with visor, blue face with green eyes, black tail with five blue stripes, original Omnitrix on chest. Ben 10,000's XLR8 is taller with white stripes, longer sleeves and a scanner visor.
Same as the Original Series but slightly darker skin and more muscular, drawn in Generator Rex's style; Ultimatrix on chest.
Taller; the white on the shirt becomes green and covers the neck; four tail stripes; bigger foot-balls; darker visor. 11-year-old keeps a white shirt and has three tail stripes.

score.rationale: Supersonic runner who effectively stops time, runs on walls and water and whips up lifting vortexes; hits hard for his size but is a light-weight melee fighter. Magnets, ice and sticky surfaces neutralise him.

notes: UA record rests solely on the Heroes United crossover (a Generator Rex episode; wiki lists it under 'Generator Rex'); XLR8 was re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns but never used in a UA episode proper - flag for QA if crossovers should be excluded.
Not used in Alien Force (locked).
Also used by Ken (Ken 10) and Gwen 10 (And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
